Protest at Jantar Mantar Turns Violent as Woman Throws Ink at CJP Founder

A woman threw an ink-like liquid at CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke during a protest at Jantar Mantar, where he was on hunger strike. The incident occurred after police took away another protester, Sonam Wangchuk, to the hospital. The CJP founder has been on hunger strike for 20 days, demanding justice for Wangchuk.
